title: VooPoo UForce-L Replacement Glass 2ml
description: Replacement Glass 2ml for the VooPoo UForce-L Sub-Ohm Tank x 1 The Voopoo Uforce-L sub-ohm tank 2ml is a precision-engineered vape tank with adjustable, 3-inlet airflow control that not only lets you control how tight or loose your draw is but helps prevent leaks and the build-up of condensation. Heatsink technology also helps prevent your tank getting too hot, ensuring every puff is consistently comfortable. Voopoo’s Uforce-L sub-ohm tank is compatible with all of Voopoo’s versatile PnP series. This replacement glass tube provides a 2ml e-liquid capacity and is simple to install – insert the glass firmly over the tank cap’s rubber seal then insert the coil head and attach to the tank’s base.
